refused: Route to the robot: no route to the robot; Not already running: a run is in progress; Yard clear (Frigate): Frigate not set up; Phone app not driving it: unknown (no link to the robot); Someone home (Alarmo): unknown (Home Assistant not connected)

checks.name: No write to the robot in progress

why.title: The panel cannot reach the robot
why.fix: Check the Yarbo cloud in Settings → Robot: sign in, or wait while it reconnects

why.title: A run is already going
why.fix: Wait for it to finish, or stop it

why.title: Someone (or an animal) is in the yard, or the cameras cannot tell
why.fix: Wait until the yard is clear; check Frigate if the cameras are down

why.title: The Yarbo app is driving it, or the panel cannot tell
why.fix: Close the robot's screen in the Yarbo app. If the panel cannot tell, sign in to the Yarbo cloud (it shows the app's keep-awake) or start from the panel yourself

why.title: Nobody is home, or Home Assistant cannot tell
why.fix: Starts need someone home; check Home Assistant if it is down
